contract: GET /api/me/listening-sessions. List current-user listening sessions using page/itemsPerPage pagination, preserving counts, nullable historical metadata, timestamps and time units.

invariants.contract: GET /api/me/listening-sessions answers {total,numPages,page,itemsPerPage,sessions} with the caller playback sessions ordered by updatedAt descending in the old session shape (ids, mediaType, titles, duration, playMethod, mediaPlayer, deviceInfo, date, dayOfWeek, timeListening, startTime, currentTime, startedAt, updatedAt; date/dayOfWeek derived from updatedAt when the row has none); 401 without a valid token.

GET /api/me/listening-sessions slices by page and itemsPerPage (itemsPerPage 0 or non-numeric falls back to 10), returns an empty slice past the end with the full total, and an empty list for a user without sessions.
A playback session closed after listening appears first in GET /api/me/listening-sessions and in the item list with listened seconds, date and weekday of today.
